description.narrative: The Asian Development Fund (ADF), the Asian Development Bank's (ADB) concessional financing arm, provides assistance to the ADB's poorest member countries. The priorities for the 11th ADF replenishment (known as ADF 12) for the period 2017-2020, include gender equality, infrastructure, private sector development, governance, and climate change. ADF 12 also includes dedicated funding for disaster risk reduction. Australia has been a leading supporter of the ADF and has retained an 11 per cent burden share and status as the second largest donor with a contribution of $468.5 million.
